'''Jandoonian salamanders''' were a type of [[Salamander/Legends|salamander]] found on the<ref name="TRG" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Relic">{{JournalCite|6|Relic (article)}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jandoon]]. They could be domesticated and kept as pets.<ref name="TRG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jandoonian salamanders were mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', a [[1997]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Bill Smith]].<ref name="TRG" />
